name: Kozuch Football Performance Complex

campus_local_conversion.projection_note: Project's local approximate degree-to-meter conversion; not surveyed CRS. GIS source geometry returned EPSG:4326 from Purdue MapServer.

source_feature.provider: Purdue Libraries campus GIS ArcGIS MapServer layer 0

sources.provider: Purdue Libraries Campus GIS / ArcGIS MapServer
sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; service source is EPSG:3857
sources.method: Use source polygon FID 1202, transform WGS84 coordinates with the project’s documented local approximation, and compare structural plan outline in campus XY.
sources.uncertainty: Source polygon represents the campus feature labelled FPC; its edge may combine the joined footprint and additions. The source map's Shape.STArea() is Web Mercator area and differs from the local approximate area.

sources.provider: Purdue University Athletics official facilities page
sources.source_date: Page describes the facility opened August 2017; current page accessed 2026-10-26
sources.method: Verify identity, address, three-level program, 112,000 square feet, use, and visible entrance against page text and official exterior photograph in sources/.
sources.uncertainty: Published gross floor area does not provide surveyed exterior dimensions or elevations.

sources.method: Use project description and exterior image for the glass curtainwall, old gold/black palette, two-plane flight-inspired roof concept, and location between practice fields.
sources.uncertainty: No dimensioned elevations or construction drawings are published on the page.

sources.source_date: Imagery vintage is not exposed in the export response
sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 request/response, 1600x1200 pixels; export response extent [-86.9190166667, 40.4338, -86.9144833333, 40.4372]
sources.method: Overlay Purdue GIS FID 1202 on the aerial image using the export response extent; the resulting outline aligns with the white-roofed football performance building at the north end of Mollenkopf.
sources.uncertainty: The image export does not expose a dated imagery acquisition record.

sources.source_date: Project photo; page publication date not shown
sources.method: Use entrance photo to interpret glass corner, tilted stainless columns, canopy, metal panel cladding, and 1228 sign.
sources.uncertainty: Single perspective photograph; component dimensions and hidden elevations remain estimated.

sources.provider: Purdue Archives and Special Collections / Historic Facilities Database
sources.method: Cross-check identity as a three-level building adjoining the north end of Mollenkopf Athletic Center, with football locker, weight, coaching, meeting, equipment, and sports medicine areas.
sources.uncertainty: Historical narrative does not supply exact building dimensions or elevations.

geometry.height_status: estimated from three-level description and image proportions; not measured
geometry.roof: two angular overlapping flight-inspired planes, interpreted from Populous description and photos; not surveyed

model_scope.interior: Schematic visible lobby/team-hall, support-room masses, floor plates and stair; not an as-built interior. No source plans were available in this build pass.
edits: Replaced inaccurate single-block massing with a footprint derived from Purdue GIS FID 1202.
Added three levels, facade glazing/mullions, metal cladding and entrance canopy.
Added splayed stainless steel columns, Purdue P/address signage, floors and schematic lobby/support interior.

uncertainty: No measured elevation or construction drawings were found; floor heights and roof geometry are visual estimates.
A campus GIS polygon identifies the FPC building feature; existing massing footprint differs substantially, and its source could not be validated. The detailed model follows authoritative FID 1202.
Interior layout is schematic except for published program and visible lobby features.
